items.description: Pipe repair: replacement section, sealing, rock-wool insulation
items.rationale: Covered escape of water; like-for-like materials are repair costs under 7.1.7(c). Priced from the near-identical case 39 (pipe, gunmetal fittings, sealing, insulation totalling about 190).

Labour is covered under 7.1.7(g) at customary rates for the time reasonably required. In case 39 the same job took a couple of visits, with the technician-hour lines revealed at 732 or more each; as a single flat rate the estimate is moderated.
One travel charge per contractor per invoice is covered under 7.1.7(f), and this is the only one on the invoice. The prior is about 81.
Necessary drying and the equipment for it are covered under 7.1.7(b) and (e), once per drying operation. The prior is about 439 (case 39: 403 or more).

items.description: Painting disturbed wall area and closing opening
items.rationale: Making good the opening is covered under 7.1.7(a), limited to the affected patch. The prior is about 453 (case 39: 416 or more).
